provenance.basis: Illustrative. Probabilities, sizes and the age and economy multipliers are game tuning meant to produce roughly one notable event every three years, not measured rates. Amounts are in today's rupees and grow with prices. Layoff chance comes from each persona. Insurance: employer cover of 3 lakh and a premium that rises 4% a year of age after 30 are rough guesses; the player-bought covers and premiums are in stages.json.
